name: Source Logistics
tagline: The go-to logistics partner that bridges cultures to bring global products to U.S. consumers.
description:
Source Logistics is the go-to U.S. logistics partner for internationally celebrated brands, bridging cultures and supply chains to help global companies connect with American consumers. 

With over 25 years of experience and a 93.8% customer retention rate, Source Logistics is a trusted, award-winning 3PL provider for some of the world’s most recognized food, beverage, health, beauty, and consumer product brands. From artisan producers to Fortune 500, we help our clients scale with confidence through flexible, integrated, and tech-enabled logistics solutions. 

Our services are purpose-built to support brands entering or expanding in the U.S. market: 

Warehousing 
25 U.S. facilities spanning over 5.8 million sq ft offer dry, ambient, refrigerated, and frozen storage. Our operations include cross-docking, pick & pack, lot and expiration tracking, and real-time visibility through our new customer portal. 

Transportation Management 
Our end-to-end freight services include carrier procurement and optimization, rate negotiation, freight consolidation, and load planning. Integrated TMS and WMS platforms provide full transparency, shipment tracking, and KPI reporting. 

Ecommerce Fulfillment 
Source Logistics powers scalable, tech-driven B2B and B2C omnichannel fulfillment with platform integrations, custom kitting, branded packaging, and returns management, plus discounted shipping through national and regional carriers. 

Value-Added Services 
From kitting, bundling, and labeling to temperature-sensitive handling, retail display builds, and quality inspections, we offer tailored services to meet the unique needs of industries like food, healthcare, retail, and CPG. 

At Source Logistics, we combine cultural fluency with logistics expertise, giving global brands a trusted, U.S.-based partner with decades of international experience that’s as invested in their growth as they are.

similarOrganizations.name: Yukon Real Estate Partners
similarOrganizations.description:
Yukon Real Estate Partners is a fully integrated real estate investment and development company focused on the development and acquisition of cold storage and food logistic focused assets. 

Recognizing a severely restricted supply and an increasing demand for space from users of all sizes and maturities, Yukon set out to bridge the cold storage supply gap by providing operators with tailored space solutions for their cold supply chain needs.

A critical link in America’s fresh and frozen food supply chain, cold storage has been historically underbuilt and underfinanced due to the complexities and costs required to keep the cold chain unbroken. Yukon is dedicated to growing the cold storage industry and to bolstering America’s food supply chain.

Yukon is an associate member of the Global Cold Chain Alliance (GCCA) and International Association of Refrigerated Warehouses (IARW).

similarOrganizations.name: The RDI Group
similarOrganizations.description:
The RDI Group operates four business units specializing in the design and manufacture of systems for the asphalt roofing, construction, telecommunications, power, metal coil processing industries, and medical industries. The machinery and manufacturing solutions designed, built and commissioned by Reichel & Drews, Chicago Slitter, RDI Laser Blanking Systems and RDI Enclosures & Systems have been helping customers improve productivity and profits since the early 1900s.

To remain focused and best serve customers in these diverse markets, each business unit maintains dedicated product management, sales and marketing, engineering, customer service, field service, and research and development functions. The business units of The RDI Group share resources including facilities, operations and manufacturing staff and other corporate functions. This shared resource strategy allows the company to provide customers with the highest value and best technology available in each industry. By actively practicing teamwork with customers and suppliers, the men and women of The RDI Group are creating competitively superior products and solutions.

The world headquarters, technical center and manufacturing operations for The RDI Group are housed in a 120,000 square foot (11,150 sq. meter) facility in Itasca, Illinois, just 30 miles (48 km) northwest of Chicago and minutes from O’Hare International Airport. Internationally, The RDI Group maintains offices in China, as well as supporting a strong network of agents and representatives worldwide.

similarOrganizations.name: University of London
similarOrganizations.description:
The University of London is the UK’s largest provider of international online and distance education, which it delivers in partnership with 17 federation member universities, to improve access to higher education around the world.

The University’s purpose is to increase access to education, champion research excellence and deliver social good.

More than 40,000 students in over 190 countries around the world are studying University of London programmes.

The federation of the University of London is made up of 17 renowned higher education institutions. Collectively this federation contributes to making London the global capital for Higher Education; London is home to more top-ranking universities than any other city worldwide.

The University of London is also a national leader in the humanities, promoting and facilitating research across disciplines and advocating for the humanities and their importance to society.

While rooted in London, the University was founded on the ideals of inclusivity, diversity and collaboration and its global community is united by a common belief: that the power of collective expertise can transform people’s lives.
